items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, and Eagle Eye [Shields]. [INTERVIEWEE] Right, right.

ctx.x: but he was a combination. He was a great piano player. He was the daddy of the stride piano. You know the stride piano, where they -- he was the daddy of the stride piano. Him and guys like James P. Johnson and all those guys.
